# Homedit

> > Homedit is a home design and DIY inspiration website featuring tutorials, decoration ideas, and interior design guides for creative homeowners.

Homedit provides practical DIY tutorials, seasonal craft projects, and home decoration inspiration across interior design, furniture upcycling, and creative living spaces. The site features step-by-step guides for handmade projects alongside curated design ideas for every room and season.

## Key Topics

- DIY tutorials
- Home decor
- Interior design
- Craft projects
- Holiday decorations
- Seasonal crafts
- Furniture upcycling
- Natural home scents
- Party decorations
- Easter crafts
- Halloween decor
- Space-saving solutions
- Outdoor lighting
- Asian-inspired design
- Architectural courtyards

## DIY Tutorials & Craft Projects

- [How to Make Your Own Tile Table](https://www.homedit.com/how-to-make-your-own-tile-table): Tutorial on upcycling leftover tiles into mosaic furniture makeovers
- [DIY Etched Glass Terrarium](https://www.homedit.com/diy-etched-glass-terrarium): Glass etching tutorial for customizing terrariums with etching cream
- [DIY Lighting Fixture Designs For The Backyard](https://www.homedit.com/diy-lighting-fixture-designs-for-the-backyard): Outdoor lighting DIY projects using mason jars, wine bottles, and tin cans
- [DIY Mini Chalkboard Wall Hanging](https://www.homedit.com/chalkboard-wall-hanging): Back-to-school craft tutorial for mini chalkboard wall hanging with E6000

## Home Decor & Interior Design

- [15 Best Ways to Make your Home Smell Good](https://www.homedit.com/best-ways-to-make-your-home-smell-good): Natural home scent solutions and DIY deodorizer methods for fresh homes
- [Add Dimension And Color To Your Home With 3D Wall Art](https://www.homedit.com/add-dimension-color-home-3d-wall-art): 3D wall art ideas featuring geometric designs and DIY craft projects
- [Quirky And Attractive Tripod Floor Lamp Designs](https://www.homedit.com/versatile-tripod-floor-lamps): Tripod floor lamp designs from West Elm and Etsy in various styles
- [Bejewel Your Home With Beautiful Decorative Hardware](https://www.homedit.com/beautiful-decorative-hardware): Decorative hardware trends from ICFF 2016 featuring door knobs and pulls
- [Incorporating Asian-Inspired Style Into Modern Décor](https://www.homedit.com/incorporating-asian-inspired-style-modern-decor): Asian-inspired design tips featuring Zen, Chinoiserie, and bamboo elements
- [How To Refresh The Foot Of Your Bed With Style – 15 Inspiring Ideas](https://www.homedit.com/how-to-refresh-the-foot-of-your-bed-with-style): Bedroom styling ideas for furniture placement at the foot of the bed

## Holiday & Seasonal Decorations

- [DIY Halloween Chandelier From A Bird Cage](https://www.homedit.com/halloween-chandelier): Tutorial for creating Halloween chandelier by upcycling a bird cage
- [Create a Ghostly Halloween Bar: A DIY Table Runner and Toxic Drinks](https://www.homedit.com/create-ghostly-halloween-bar-diy-table-runner-toxic-drinks): Halloween party tutorial with ghost table runner and neon cocktail recipes
- [Marbled Christmas Crackers](https://www.homedit.com/marbled-christmas-crackers): Christmas cracker DIY using nail varnish marbling technique for tables
- [20 Alternative Gift Wrapping Ideas That Entice Your Creativity](https://www.homedit.com/gift-wrapping-ideas): Creative gift wrapping alternatives with handmade bows and wooden tags
